title: Balanced-column carry exchanges: conditional κ = 5.1915547765237e-5
body:
This PR composes balanced coarse columns with envelope ordering and carried-signal exchanges to obtain the conditional bound

$$
T(n)=O\left(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}\right),\qquad
\kappa=\frac{51915547765237}{10^{18}}=5.1915547765237\times10^{-5}.
$$

Against the updated PR #74 at `5830ccfca8466aff613767222558e29b57fa8225`, whose reported κ is `10366199626713/(2*10^17)`, the exact gain is **10568703959/125000000000000000**, or **0.163125609609%**. Against PR #76 the gain is **5527241253/31250000000000000**, or **0.3418559067%**. These compare pinned conditional claims, not globally optimal bounds. Bit saving is **3244890195589/62500000000000000**. All inherited theorem hypotheses remain conditional.

## Change

Replace each coarse two-group total by a balanced sum of column sums, using the anchored PR #69/#77 graph adapter. Compose that graph with the `[1,1,2]` anchored split, PR #74 envelope-node ordering, cover-core/reverse-node schedules, and three-pass carried-signal exchanges from PR #76.

Every summand remains present exactly once with disjoint support; support interning can reuse column sums in interval strips. After node renumbering, invalidate the adapter's node-ID support cache and verify again. An independent dense support audit checks the scalar/data-output identities without that cache. Frame containment, dirty wrappers, next-use scoring, literal XORs and all paid transitions remain checked. PR #77's separate cost-ordered clearing compiler is not imported.

| Quantity | PR #76 | This PR |
|---|---:|---:|
| h=23 auxiliary roles | 27,256 | **27,128** |
| h=25 auxiliary roles | 35,720 | **35,598** |
| Physical wires W | 134,095,520 | **133,585,058** |
| Bit saving | 25870676537201/(5*10^17) | **3244890195589/62500000000000000** |
| Conditional κ | 51738676045141/10^18 | **51915547765237/10^18** |
| Assembly backoff | 10^-12 | unchanged |

The complete paid recursive rank is **76,809,561,450**, with deficit **1,846,900**. Endpoint copies, promotions, clearing controls, data growth and the inherited complex layer remain charged. Width-derived bridge values are wire-bit logarithm **27**, row coefficient **843**, degree **2000**, and degree gap **7007/25**.

## Verification

Ready for review following the completed focused finite checks below. Deterministic compiler regeneration and broad repository/CI review remain separate pending checks.

Passed: independent dense scalar/data-output audit; complete compiler input/dirty bases in both orientations; independent saved-word replay; exact frame/event reconstruction; regenerated complete fixed-basis profiles with zero CRT disagreements; independent rational moment bounds; all **47 strict assembly constraints and seven margins**; and adjacent bit/κ-grid rejection.

**Pending:** fresh portable deterministic compiler regeneration, broad repository checks and CI review. This PR changes no CI configuration, workflow, matrix, gate, Makefile target or verification dependency. Finite checks do not prove the inherited all-size compiler, fixed finite-alphabet tape, analytic/semantic reduction, routing, prime-selection, precision or recovery interfaces. No unconditional multiplication theorem, global optimality or practical speedup is claimed.

The copied package independently passed the dense scalar audit and complete saved-word/profile/arithmetic validation after publication. Its [current package receipt](https://github.com/DominikScholz/integer-mult-bounds/blob/acae4964aef41c69f3c57e72a45e76afc4d4934d/research/round9-balanced-columns/package-validation-receipt.json) matches the original results exactly except the updated documentation-manifest binding.

The original validation receipt binds the frozen source/artifact manifest retained in `provenance/frozen-manifest.json`. All runtime sources, physical words, profiles and arithmetic are byte-identical to that checked freeze. Only proof/comparison metadata is updated, explicitly recorded by the current manifest.

git fetch https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds.git 1bef94fd40a746452548c84a4a8f8834670a3113
mkdir -p research/round6-pr71/baseline
